value.rationale: A canonical rational genus-three plane curve has a motivated finite étale 28-bitangent scheme; determining its splitting field, six arithmetic orbit lengths and entire odd-good-prime Frobenius fixed spectrum is a natural complete arithmetic classification. It distinguishes one rational, three real-cubic and 24 degree-six bitangents and proves reduction stability without a sampling leap. These are not arbitrary parameter slices, complexity gains or mere restatements of geometric transitivity.
